verse.verse_2: And (the clouds) that bear heavy weight of water;
verse.verse_3: And (the ships) that float with ease and gentleness;
verse.verse_4: And those (angels) who distribute (provisions, rain, and other blessings) by (Allah's) Command;
verse.verse_5: Verily, that which you are promised (i.e. Resurrection in the Hereafter and receiving the reward or punishment of good or bad deeds, etc.) is surely true.
verse.verse_6: And verily, the Recompense is sure to happen.
verse.verse_7: By the heaven full of paths,
verse.verse_8: Certainly, you have different ideas (about Muhammad SAW and the Quran).
verse.verse_9: Turned aside therefrom (i.e. from Muhammad SAW and the Quran) is he who is turned aside (by the Decree and Preordainment of Allah).
verse.verse_11: Who are under a cover of heedlessness (think not about the gravity of the Hereafter),
verse.verse_12: They ask; "When will be the Day of Recompense?"
verse.verse_13: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (i.e. burnt) over the Fire!
verse.verse_14: "Taste you your trial (burning)! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"
verse.verse_15: Verily, the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2) will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs (in the Paradise),
verse.verse_16: Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this Muhsinun (good-doers - see V. 2:112).
verse.verse_17: They used to sleep but little by night [invoking their Lord (Allah) and praying, with fear and hope].
verse.verse_18: And in the hours before dawn, they were (found) asking (Allah) for forgiveness,
verse.verse_19: And in their properties there was the right of the beggar, and the Mahrum (the poor who does not ask the others).
verse.verse_20: And on the earth are signs for those who have Faith with certainty,
verse.verse_21: And also in your ownselves. Will you not then see?
verse.verse_22: And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.
verse.verse_23: Then, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth (i.e. what has been promised to you), just as it is the truth that you can speak.
verse.verse_24: Has the story reached you, of the honoured guests [three angels; Jibrael (Gabriel) along with another two] of Ibrahim (Abraham)?
verse.verse_25: When they came in to him, and said, "Salam, (peace be upon you)!" He answered; "Salam, (peace be upon you)," and said: "You are a people unknown to me,"
verse.verse_26: Then he turned to his household, so brought out a roasted calf [as the property of Ibrahim (Abraham) was mainly cows].
verse.verse_27: And placed it before them, (saying): "Will you not eat?"
verse.verse_28: Then he conceived a fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not." And they gave him glad tidings of an intelligent son, having knowledge (about Allah and His religion of True Monotheism).
verse.verse_29: Then his wife came forward with a loud voice, she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman!"
verse.verse_30: They said: "Even so says your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower."
verse.verse_31: [Ibrahim (Abraham)] said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O Messengers?"
verse.verse_32: They said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimun (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in Allah);
verse.verse_33: To send down upon them stones of baked clay.
verse.verse_34: Marked by your Lord for the Musrifun (polytheists, criminals, sinners those who trespass Allah's set limits in evil-doings by committing great sins).
verse.verse_35: So We brought out from therein the believers.
verse.verse_36: But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one [i.e. Lout (Lot) and his two daughters].
verse.verse_37: And We have left there a sign (i.e. the place of the Dead Sea, well-known in Palestine) for those who fear the painful torment.
verse.verse_38: And in Musa (Moses) (too, there is a sign). When We sent him to Fir'aun (Pharaoh) with a manifest authority.
verse.verse_39: But [Fir'aun (Pharaoh)] turned away (from Belief in might) along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer, or a madman."
verse.verse_40: So We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, while he was to be blamed.
verse.verse_41: And in 'Ad (there is also a sign) when We sent against them the barren wind;
verse.verse_42: It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.
verse.verse_43: And in Thamud (there is also a sign), when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while!"
verse.verse_44: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord, so the Sa'iqah overtook them while they were looking.
verse.verse_45: Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
verse.verse_46: (So were) the people of Nuh (Noah) before them. Verily, they were a people who were Fasiqun (rebellious, disobedient to Allah).
verse.verse_47: With power did We construct the heaven. Verily, We are Able to extend the vastness of space thereof.
verse.verse_48: And We have spread out the earth, how Excellent Spreader (thereof) are We!
verse.verse_49: And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember (the Grace of Allah).
verse.verse_50: So flee to Allah (from His Torment to His Mercy Islamic Monotheism), verily, I (Muhammad SAW) am a plain warner to you from Him.
verse.verse_51: And set not up (or worship) any other ilahan (god) along with Allah [Glorified be He (Alone), Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him]. Verily, I (Muhammad SAW) am a plain warner to you from Him.
verse.verse_52: Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them, but they said: "A sorcerer or a madman!"
verse.verse_53: Have they (the people of the past) transmitted this saying to these (Quraish pagans)? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds (in disbelief)!
verse.verse_54: So turn away (O Muhammad SAW) from them (Quraish pagans) you are not to be blamed (as you have conveyed Allah's Message).
verse.verse_55: And remind (by preaching the Quran, O Muhammad SAW) for verily, the reminding profits the believers.
verse.verse_56: And I (Allah) created not the jinns and humans except they should worship Me (Alone).
verse.verse_57: I seek not any provision from them (i.e. provision for themselves or for My creatures) nor do I ask that they should feed Me (i.e. feed themselves or My creatures).
verse.verse_58: Verily, Allah is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.
verse.verse_59: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old), so let them not ask Me to hasten on!
verse.verse_60: Then, woe to those who disbelieve (in Allah and His Oneness Islamic Monotheism) from (that) their Day which they have been promised (for their punishment).
